name: comp-486
blurb: Two number inputs for min and max values in a range.
description: A pair of number inputs (From and To) with spin buttons removed via CSS. Inputs are adjacent with focus z-index management.
use_when: Price filters, age ranges, or any min-max numeric input in forms.
avoid_when: You need a slider or drag-based range input.
a11y: Both inputs have aria-labels. Focus management via z-index. No placeholder-only labels.
